text.name: as_select_saved_appearance
text.text: Select a saved appearance to apply or delete.

text.name: as_no_saved_appearances
text.text: No saved appearances in this category.

text.name: as_save_instructions
text.text: Enter an ID, description and category for the current wardrobe appearance.

text.name: as_capture_failed
text.text: Could not capture current wardrobe appearance.

text.name: as_tip_ids
text.text: Tip: IDs are stored without spaces; the description is shown in the selector.

text.name: as_save_failed_not_ready
text.text: Save failed: AvatarSwitcher is not ready.

text.name: as_delete_confirm_body
text.text: This will remove the selected AvatarSwitcher preset.

text.name: as_delete_current_unchanged
text.text: The current in-game appearance will not be changed.

text.name: as_hud_hint
text.text: Use the mapped Open Avatar Switcher control, then select with the mouse.

text.name: as_new_category_example
text.text: Leave blank, or type e.g. Seasonal

text.name: as_validation_ready_id_name
text.text: Ready to save. The Preset ID will also be used as the display name.

text.name: as_help_preset_id_text
text.text:
A unique internal key used by Avatar Switcher and compatible mods.
Example: jen_winter_workwear
Spaces are saved as underscores. Use letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.

text.name: as_help_display_name_text
text.text:
The readable name shown in the Avatar Switcher menu.
Example: Jen – Winter Workwear
Leave it blank to use the Preset ID.

text.name: as_help_category_text
text.text:
Select one of the categories already used by saved avatars.
The selected row is used unless a value is entered in New Category.

text.name: as_help_new_category_text
text.text:
Type a new category name to create it while saving.
Example: Seasonal
Leave this field blank to use the selected existing category.
